missions.title: New Turf
missions.intro: Ma Rachel: "So you're the one from Westridge everyone's talking about. Walk with me: see the field, the spaza, and greet Uncle Solly at Kings Cuts."

missions.title: Clean Cut
missions.intro: Uncle Solly: "My clipper blades are at the café in Westridge, the auntie there keeps them for me. Fetch them before closing? No blades, no fades."
missions.description: A cross-district errand for the barber.
missions.fail_text: The café closed. Solly cuts with scissors today and he is not happy.

objectives.text: Fetch the blades from Westridge Cafe (Westridge)
Bring them to Uncle Solly in Lentegeur

missions.title: Dune Truce
missions.intro: Ma Rachel: "The Dune Cruisers chase the kids off the field every night. Talk to Spider, then stand on that field with your crew. Show them it belongs to everyone."

objectives.text: Talk to Spider at the Dune Cruisers' flats (8 Spine Road)
Hold the soccer field with your crew after dark

intro_by_crew.duin_boys: Ma Rachel: "I know you run with the Dune Cruisers, child. Then talk to Spider for me, and let the kids play on that field at night. Stand there with your crew so everyone sees it's agreed."
